notes.title: Store Page Live!
notes.content:
Woohoo Celebrate!

The store page is finally live, which means you can add Jubeez to your wishlist... *Wink Wink*.

The game is just about done, but we're missing a few key features such as the "Exit Game Button". Not that we think you'll want to quit the game, but just in case right?

We're also adding in a tutorial so everyone can learn how to play this unique puzzler, but we're sure you're clever enough to figure it out on your own!

The game should be ready within the next week, but due to the restrictions imposed by Steam we can only release it two weeks after this announcement. In the meantime, enjoy this trailer which we happened to find rather hilarious due to our mental age.
